jobs.description:
Job Purpose

The Global Launch Education Manager is responsible for the successful commercialization of our products and solutions from an education perspective, driving adoption and contributing to business impact through scalable education programs.

This position reports to the Head of Global Launch Education.

In this role, he/she collaborates with cross-functional launch core teams and takes ownership to clearly frame the T&E contribution to the launch business case. He/she leads our staff, key opinion leaders, speakers, and relevant customer groups, to understand, adopt, apply, sell, position, and promote our workflows, by delivering end-to-end, workflow-based education approaches, including:

  • Developing T&E go-to-market concepts, education materials, and learning formats with clear and trackable impact.
  • Securing knowledge transfer to relevant internal and external stakeholders, clinical relevance across the workflow, technical features and benefits, competitiveness, and safe handling of our workflow solutions.
  • Developing and delivering high-quality, updated, differentiated, accessible, and blended T&E education materials, learning formats, and learning experiences that empower internal and external target audiences to learn, cascade, and multiply our launch intentions, ensuring scalability and consistency across markets.

The main interfaces of this position include:

  • Global Medical Education teams
  • Global Product Management & Workflow Management teams
  • Connected Customer Solutions teams
  • ITI Education teams
  • Internal downstream trainers, marketing and sales management teams
  • External experts, speakers, and key opinion leaders

Main Tasks and • Responsibilities

Learning content packages & trainings:

  • Collaborate with Product & Workflow Managers and launch core teams to develop and provide consistent, scalable, and didactically sound learning objectives and content for different target groups, including:
    • Indication-based treatment principles
    • Technical features and benefits
    • Content kits (i.e. PPT presentations, images, videos, animations)
    • End-to-end clinical case narratives
  • Manage, upkeep, and deploy learning packages per relevant stakeholder groups.
  • Implement launch trainings per relevant internal and external targets and secure knowledge transfer of key learning objectives, ensuring T&E readiness before launch and supporting post-launch effectiveness and adoption
  • Translate complex clinical and digital workflow solutions into practical, scalable, and easy-to-adopt education experiences for diverse learner audiences.
  • Design scalable digital learning experiences including eLearning, video-based learning, self-paced education, instructor-led training, and blended learning solutions for global audiences.
  • Collaborate with KOLs to co-create clinically relevant and impactful educational content.

Education/Professional Experience

  • Graduate in Dentistry or a related dental field (e.g. dental technician, dental nurse) with strong knowledge of implantology, prosthodontics, ITI SAC Classification, treatment guidelines, and scientific consensus statements.
  • Clinical experience in implantology and digital workflows is an advantage.
  • Experience designing and delivering global education programs, including lecturing, hands-on training, instructor-led, digital, and blended learning formats.
  • Competence working with MS Office programs (PowerPoint, Word, Excel etc.)
  • Strong oral and written communication and presentation skills.
  • Experience in adult education is an advantage.
  • Fluency in English is mandatory; other languages are an advantage.
  • Experience in innovation launches and cross-functional collaboration.

Personal Attributes

  • Motivated self-starter, well-structured, able to navigate complexity, with a high energy level
  • Team-spirited with a pragmatic hands-on approach
  • Results-oriented with a strong business sense
  • Well-organized and collaborative working style
  • Effective communication and listening skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to establish effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders at all levels
  • Strong presence and ability to influence
  • Ability to travel 0-30%


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

Employment Type: Full Time

Alternative Locations: Switzerland : Basel

Travel Percentage: 0 - 40%

Requisition ID: 21609

descriptionByLocale.it:
Scopo del lavoro

Il Global Launch Education Manager è responsabile della commercializzazione di successo dei nostri prodotti e soluzioni dal punto di vista educativo, guidando l'adozione e contribuendo all'impatto commerciale attraverso programmi di formazione a scala mobile.

Questa posizione riferisce al capo della Global Launch Education.

In questo ruolo, collabora con i core team di lancio cross-funzionali e si appropria di inquadrare chiaramente il contributo T&E al business case di lancio. Lui/lei guida il nostro personale, i leader di opinione chiave, gli oratori e i gruppi di clienti pertinenti, per capire, adottare, applicare, vendere, posizionare e promuovere i nostri flussi di lavoro, fornendo approcci educativi end-to-end, basati sul flusso di lavoro, tra cui:

- Sviluppare concetti di mercato, materiali didattici e formati di apprendimento con un impatto chiaro e tracciabile.

- Garantire il trasferimento delle conoscenze ai soggetti interessati interni ed esterni, la rilevanza clinica per tutto il flusso di lavoro, le caratteristiche tecniche e i vantaggi, la competitività e la gestione sicura delle nostre soluzioni di flusso di lavoro.

- Sviluppare e fornire materiali educativi T&E di alta qualità, aggiornati, differenziati, accessibili e miscelati, formati di apprendimento e esperienze di apprendimento che consentano ai destinatari interni ed esterni di apprendere, a cascata e moltiplicare le nostre intenzioni di lancio, garantendo la possibilità di scalabilità e coerenza nei mercati.

Le principali interfacce di questa posizione comprendono:

- Global Medical Education Teams

- Team di gestione globale dei prodotti e dei flussi di lavoro

- Team di soluzioni clienti collegate

- ITI Squadre di istruzione

- Formazione interna a valle, marketing e gestione delle vendite

- Esperti esterni, relatori e opinion leader chiave

Principali compiti e responsabilità

Imparare i pacchetti di contenuti e le formazioni:

- il 21a con i Product & Workflow Manager e il lancio di squadre di base per sviluppare e fornire obiettivi e contenuti di apprendimento coerenti, scalabili e didatticamente validi per diversi gruppi target, tra cui: - principi di trattamento basati sull'indicazione

- Caratteristiche tecniche e vantaggi

- Kit di contenuto (ad es. presentazioni PPT, immagini, video, animazioni)

- End-to-end narrative di casi clinici

- Gestire, mantenere e distribuire pacchetti di apprendimento per i gruppi interessati.

- attuare corsi di formazione per ciascun obiettivo interno ed esterno pertinente e garantire il trasferimento delle conoscenze dei principali obiettivi di apprendimento, assicurando la disponibilità delle T&E prima del lancio e sostenendo l'efficacia e l'adozione post-lancio;

- Tradurre soluzioni complesse di flusso di lavoro clinico e digitale in esperienze pratiche, di facile adattamento e di facile adozione per diversi spettatori.

- Progettare esperienze di apprendimento digitale di scalabilità tra cui eLearning, apprendimento basato su video, formazione auto-aced, formazione guidata da istruttori e soluzioni di apprendimento miste per il pubblico globale.

- Il gruppo ha inoltre un ruolo importante nella creazione di contenuti educativi clinicamente rilevanti e di impatto.

Istruzione/Esperienza professionale

- Laureato in Odontoiatria o in campo dentale correlato (ad es. tecnico odontoiatrico, infermiere dentale) con una forte conoscenza dell'implantologia, della prostodonzia, della classificazione ITI SAC, delle linee guida per il trattamento e delle dichiarazioni scientifiche di consenso.

- L'esperienza clinica in implantologia e flussi di lavoro digitali è un vantaggio.

- Esperienza nella progettazione e fornitura di programmi educativi globali, tra cui lecture, formazione pratica, guidate da istruttori, digitale e formati di apprendimento misti.

- Competenza con i programmi MS Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel ecc.)

- Forte capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta e presentazione.

- L'esperienza nell'educazione degli adulti è un vantaggio.

- La fluidità in inglese è obbligatoria; altre lingue sono un vantaggio.

- L'esperienza nell'innovazione lancia e collabora in modo interfunzionale.

Attributi personali

- Autoavviamento motivato, ben strutturato, in grado di navigare nella complessità, con un alto livello energetico

- Team-spirited con un approccio pratico

- Orientato ai risultati con un forte senso di business

- Stile di lavoro ben organizzato e collaborativo

- Capacità efficaci di comunicazione e ascolto

- Eccellenti competenze interpersonali, con la capacità di stabilire efficaci rapporti di lavoro con stakeholder interni ed esterni a tutti i livelli

- Forte presenza e capacità di influenza

- Capacità di viaggiare 0-30%

Tutti i candidati qualificati riceveranno un'indennità di disoccupazione senza riguardo alla razza, alla religione, al sesso, all'orientamento sessuale, all'identità di genere, all'origine nazionale o alla disabilità.

Tipo di occupazione: a tempo pieno

Località alternative: Svizzera : Basilea

Percentuale di viaggio: 0 - 40%

Aufgabenbereich

Der Global Launch Education Manager ist verantwortlich für die erfolgreiche Vermarktung unserer Produkte und Lösungen aus Bildungssicht, die Adoption und den Beitrag zu unternehmerischen Auswirkungen durch skalierbare Bildungsprogramme.

Diese Position berichtet an den Leiter der Global Launch Education.

In dieser Rolle arbeitet er mit funktionsübergreifenden Start-Core-Teams zusammen und übernimmt die Verantwortung, um den T&E-Beitrag zum Start-Business-Fall klar zu gestalten. Er leitet unsere Mitarbeiter, wichtigen Meinungsführer, Referenten und relevante Kundengruppen, um unsere Arbeitsabläufe zu verstehen, anzunehmen, anzuwenden, zu verkaufen, zu positionieren und zu fördern, indem er durchgängige, workflowbasierte Bildungsansätze liefert, darunter:

- Entwicklung von T&E-Go-to-Market-Konzepten, Bildungsmaterialien und Lernformaten mit klaren und trackablen Auswirkungen.

- Sicherung des Wissenstransfers an relevante interne und externe Stakeholder, klinische Relevanz über den Workflow hinweg, technische Features und Vorteile, Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und sichere Handhabung unserer Workflow-Lösungen.

- Entwicklung und Bereitstellung hochwertiger, aktualisierter, differenzierter, zugänglicher und kombinierter T&E-Bildungsmaterialien, Lernformate und Lernerfahrungen, die interne und externe Zielgruppen befähigen, unsere Startabsichten zu lernen, zu kaskaden und zu vervielfachen, um Skalierbarkeit und Konsistenz über die Märkte hinweg zu gewährleisten.

Die wichtigsten Schnittstellen dieser Position sind:

- Globale medizinische Bildungsteams

- Globale Produktmanagement- & Workflow-Management-Teams

- Connected Customer Solutions Teams

- ITI-Bildungsteams

- Interne nachgeschaltete Trainer, Marketing- und Vertriebsmanagement-Teams

- Externe Experten, Referenten und führende Meinungsführer

Wichtigste Aufgaben und
• Zuständigkeiten

Lerninhaltepakete & Schulungen:

- Zusammenarbeit mit Produkt- & Workflow-Managern und Start-Core-Teams, um konsistente, skalierbare und didaktische Lernziele und Inhalte für verschiedene Zielgruppen zu entwickeln und bereitzustellen, darunter: - Indikationsbasierte Behandlungsgrundsätze

- Technische Merkmale und Vorteile

- Content Kits (PPT-Präsentationen, Bilder, Videos, Animationen)

- Ende-zu-Ende-Klinik-Erzählungen

- Verwalten, Pflegen und Bereitstellung von Lernpaketen für relevante Stakeholdergruppen.

- Einführung von Schulungen für die jeweiligen internen und externen Ziele und Sicherung des Wissenstransfers wichtiger Lernziele, Gewährleistung der T&E-Vorbereitung vor Einführung und Unterstützung der Wirksamkeit und Annahme nach der Einführung

- Übersetzen Sie komplexe klinische und digitale Workflow-Lösungen in praktische, skalierbare und leicht zu bedienende Bildungserfahrungen für unterschiedliche Lerner-Publikume.

- Entwerfen skalierbarer digitaler Lernerfahrungen, einschließlich eLearning, videobasiertes Lernen, selbstgedämpfte Bildung, lehrergeführte Ausbildung und Blended-Learning-Lösungen für globales Publikum.

- Zusammenarbeit mit KOLs zur Ko-Erstellung klinisch relevanter und einflussreicher Bildungsinhalte.

Ausbildung/Berufserfahrung

- Absolventin in Zahnmedizin oder einem verwandten zahnärztlichen Bereich (z.B. Zahntechniker, Zahnpfleger) mit starken Kenntnissen in der Implantologie, Prosthodontik, ITI SAC-Klassifikation, Behandlungsrichtlinien und wissenschaftlichen Konsensaussagen.

- Klinische Erfahrung in der Implantologie und digitalen Workflows ist ein Vorteil.

- Erfahrung bei der Gestaltung und Bereitstellung globaler Bildungsprogramme, einschließlich Lehrveranstaltungen, praktische Ausbildung, lehrergeführte, digitale und gemischte Lernformate.

- Die fließende Englischkenntnisse sind verpflichtend; andere Sprachen sind ein Vorteil.

- Erfahrung in der Innovations-Starts und funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Objectif de l'emploi

Le responsable de l'éducation Global Launch est responsable de la commercialisation réussie de nos produits et solutions dans une perspective éducative, en favorisant l'adoption et en contribuant à l'impact des affaires par des programmes d'éducation évolutives.

Cette position relève du chef de l'éducation mondiale.

Dans ce rôle, il collabore avec des équipes de base de lancement interfonctionnelles et s'approprie clairement la contribution de T&E au lancement. Il dirige notre personnel, nos leaders d'opinion clés, nos conférenciers et les groupes de clients concernés, pour comprendre, adopter, appliquer, vendre, positionner et promouvoir nos workflows, en offrant des approches éducatives de bout en bout, basées sur les flux de travail, notamment :

- Élaborer des concepts de T&E qui se mettent en marché, du matériel éducatif et des formats d'apprentissage qui ont un impact clair et visible.

- Assurer le transfert des connaissances aux intervenants internes et externes concernés, la pertinence clinique dans l'ensemble du flux de travail, les caractéristiques et avantages techniques, la compétitivité et la gestion sécuritaire de nos solutions de flux de travail.

- Élaborer et fournir des matériels pédagogiques, des formats d'apprentissage et des expériences d'apprentissage de haute qualité, mis à jour, différenciés, accessibles et combinés qui permettent aux publics cibles internes et externes d'apprendre, en cascade, et de multiplier nos intentions de lancement, en assurant l'évolutivité et la cohérence entre les marchés.

Les principales interfaces de cette position sont les suivantes:

- Équipes mondiales de formation médicale

- Équipes de gestion de produits et de gestion de flux de travail

- Équipes de Solutions Client connectées

- Équipes de formation de l'ITI

- Formateurs internes en aval, équipes de gestion du marketing et des ventes

- Experts externes, conférenciers et leaders d'opinions clés

Principales tâches et responsabilités

Les programmes d'apprentissage et les formations :

- Collaborer avec les gestionnaires de produits et de flux de travail et lancer des équipes de base pour élaborer et fournir des objectifs et des contenus d'apprentissage cohérents, évolutifs et d'une qualité pratique pour différents groupes cibles, y compris : - des principes de traitement fondés sur des indications

- Caractéristiques et avantages techniques

- Kits de contenu (présentations, images, vidéos, animations)

- Narrations de cas cliniques de bout en bout

- Gérer, entretenir et déployer des modules d'apprentissage par groupe d'intervenants concernés.

- Mettre en oeuvre des formations par objectif interne et externe pertinent et assurer le transfert des connaissances des principaux objectifs d'apprentissage, en assurant la préparation aux T-E avant le lancement et en appuyant l'efficacité et l'adoption après le lancement

- Traduire des solutions complexes de flux de travail cliniques et numériques en expériences d'éducation pratiques, évolutives et faciles à adopter pour divers publics apprenants.

- Concevoir des expériences d'apprentissage numérique évolutives, y compris l'apprentissage électronique, l'apprentissage vidéo, l'éducation auto-programmée, la formation dirigée par un instructeur et des solutions d'apprentissage mixte pour les publics mondiaux.

- Collaborer avec les KOLs pour créer un contenu éducatif cliniquement pertinent et impactant.

Expérience professionnelle/éducation

- Diplômé en dentisterie ou dans un domaine dentaire connexe (p. ex. technicien dentaire, infirmière dentaire) ayant une solide connaissance de l'implantologie, de la pathodontie, de la classification des CSC de l'ITI, des lignes directrices de traitement et des énoncés de consensus scientifique.

- L'expérience clinique en implantologie et en flux de travail numériques est un avantage.

- Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des programmes d'éducation mondiaux, y compris des séances de lecturation, des formations pratiques, des programmes dirigés par des instructeurs, des formats numériques et des formats d'apprentissage mixtes.

- Compétence en matière de programmes MS Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel, etc.)

- Fortes aptitudes en communication orale et écrite et en présentation.

- L'expérience de l'éducation des adultes est un avantage.

- La maîtrise de l'anglais est obligatoire; d'autres langues sont un avantage.

- Expérience dans le lancement de l'innovation et la collaboration interfonctionnelle.

Attributs personnels

- Autodémarrage motivé, bien structuré, capable de naviguer dans la complexité, avec un niveau d'énergie élevé

- Une équipe d'esprit d'équipe avec une approche pragmatique et pratique

- Des résultats orientés vers un sens fort de l'entreprise

- Style de travail bien organisé et collaboratif

- Capacités de communication et d'écoute efficaces

- Excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles, avec la capacité d'établir des relations de travail efficaces avec les intervenants internes et externes à tous les niveaux

- Forte présence et capacité d'influence

- Capacité de voyager 0-30%

jobs.description:
At Straumann Group we’re on an exciting journey of growth, innovation, and impact - driven by our mission to improve oral health and transform millions of lives worldwide. United by purpose, we bring our best selves to work every day, embracing a high-performance, player-learner culture that inspires collaboration, curiosity, and ambition. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to take charge of your own career, harnessing your skills, passion, and enthusiasm for learning to continually grow and progress. Together, we’re not just shaping brighter smiles, we’re unlocking the potential of people everywhere, including our own.

We are looking for you as our Trainee Global Product Management. In this position, you will drive global product manager efficiency by taking ownership and orchestrating life cycle tasks and cross functional projects. You will develop expertise in Product Management tasks and processes and collaborate across different departments at Straumann. You will be part of the Product Management team in the Implantology Business Unit, based at the HQ in Basel.

The position is temporary for one year.


• Your responsibilities:

  • Anlayses product portfolio rentability and manages product phase-out decision making and implementation
  • Orchestrate portfolio geo expansion including e-shop launch management in close collaboration with the e-shop team and product managers
  • Supports the Medical Device Regulation related product documentation updates
  • Manages product data harmonization in SAP and tracks IFU and product label changes
  • Leads Product Management tasks in cross functional projects in close collaboration with the responsible Product Managers and the departments involved
  • Takes ownership for effective and transparent communication between stakeholders, feeding different channels, and continuously searching for tools and ways to improve it.


Your • Profile - • Qualifications

Education

  • Degree in life sciences, business administration or equivalent, experience in marketing topics as well as project management is an advantage

Experience

  • Affinity for data and analytics
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • At least 6 months of working experience, preferably in an international matrix organization
  • Open minded and proactive personality with the ability to cultivate a network of effective working relationships in an international matrix environment as well as to motivate and engage stakeholders
  • Fluent in English, any other language is an asset

  • Open, friendly colleagues who #collaborate and #support each other: We are #Players+Learners.

  • The #opportunity to develop yourself as a person and in your #career. We #grow.
  • #Attractive workplaces at great locations - We are a #GlobalPlayer.
  • A good salary and many other cool #benefits (depending on location).
  • To work for the No. 1 in #Dentistry and one of the leading #MedTech companies.

jobs.description:
At Straumann Group we’re on an exciting journey of growth, innovation, and impact - driven by our mission to improve oral health and transform millions of lives worldwide. United by purpose, we bring our best selves to work every day, embracing a high-performance, player-learner culture that inspires collaboration, curiosity, and ambition. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to take charge of your own career, harnessing your skills, passion, and enthusiasm for learning to continually grow and progress. Together, we’re not just shaping brighter smiles, we’re unlocking the potential of people everywhere, including our own.

Packaging plays a critical role in ensuring the safety, integrity, and usability of our medical devices throughout the entire product lifecycle. Beyond protecting the product, packaging must comply with global regulatory requirements, enable efficient manufacturing and logistics, support sustainability ambitions, and deliver excellent customer experience.
We are looking for an experienced and collaborative Packaging Development Engineer to join our Global Packaging team at Straumann Group Headquarters in Basel.
In this role, you will take ownership of complex packaging development and Life Cycle Management (LCM) initiatives across our global product portfolio. You will lead technical packaging projects from concept through implementation, working closely with colleagues from Research & Development, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, Procurement, Marketing, and external suppliers.
As a technical expert, you will contribute to the evolution of our packaging platforms, engineering standards, and development processes while supporting the successful transfer, optimization, and continuous improvement of existing products across our global manufacturing network.
This position offers the opportunity to influence packaging strategy, drive innovation, and shape the future of medical device packaging within Straumann Group. The role reports to the Head of Packaging, LCM SDIS & RDI Academy, is based at the company's headquarters in Basel, Switzerland, and requires moderate international travel.


• Your responsibilities:

  • Lead complex packaging development and Life Cycle Management (LCM) projects, from concept through implementation, for new and existing products.
  • Design innovative, robust, and cost-effective packaging solutions that meet product, manufacturing, regulatory, quality, and customer requirements.
  • Drive technical decisions for complex packaging challenges across multiple product families.

Project & Technical Leadership

  • Manage packaging development projects, including planning, timelines, risk assessment, resource coordination, and stakeholder communication.
  • Lead packaging activities supporting global product transfers, manufacturing site localization, supplier changes, and business continuity initiatives.
  • Plan, coordinate, and evaluate packaging verification and validation activities, including transportation testing, shelf-life studies, sterile barrier validation, and compatibility testing.
  • Conduct feasibility studies, engineering evaluations, and cost analyses to identify optimal packaging solutions balancing quality, compliance, manufacturability, sustainability, and total cost of ownership.


Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Provide technical leadership across global cross-functional teams, partnering with Engineering, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, Procurement, and Marketing.
  • Collaborate with suppliers and external partners to identify, qualify, and implement innovative packaging materials, technologies, and manufacturing processes.
  • Build strong collaborative relationships with global stakeholders, manufacturing sites, suppliers, and packaging experts across the Straumann Group.


Standards, Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Define, improve, and maintain global packaging engineering standards, design guidelines, specifications, and best practices.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize packaging design, materials, manufacturing processes, and environmental performance.
  • Monitor emerging technologies, regulatory developments, sustainability trends, and industry standards, translating them into practical engineering solutions.


Expertise & Knowledge Sharing

  • Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for packaging-related topics during internal and external audits, inspections, and regulatory assessments.
  • Mentor colleagues, share technical expertise, and contribute to the continuous development of packaging engineering capabilities across the organization.


Your • Profile - • Qualifications

Education

• Minimum 3 years of experience in packaging development, medical device development, or another regulated industry.
• Experience leading technical projects in cross-functional and international environments.
• Good knowledge of packaging materials, packaging technologies, manufacturing processes, and packaging test methodologies.
• Knowledge of medical device development processes with a good understanding of product and user workflows.
• Experience in project management with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results within agreed timelines.
• Understanding of regulatory requirements and industry standards related to medical device packaging, including ISO, ASTM, ISTA, MDR, FDA, and sustainability requirements.
• Knowledge of sterile packaging systems, sealing technologies, and sterilization processes.
• Experience with sterile barrier system validation and related test methods (e.g., seal strength, dye penetration, bubble emission, visual inspection) is considered an advantage.
• Good understanding of Design Control processes for medical devices.
• Experience applying engineering tools such as risk management, technical drawings, statistical analysis, and material performance evaluation.
• Proven ability to identify opportunities for innovation and implement packaging improvements that enhance product performance, manufacturing efficiency, sustainability, or cost competitiveness

Personal Attributes

• Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Collaborative team player with excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to build trusted relationships across functions, cultures, and global organizations.
• Takes ownership, makes sound engineering decisions, and delivers pragmatic solutions.
• Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain technical topics to different audiences.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken; additional languages are an advantage.
• Curious, proactive, and motivated by continuous learning and technical excellence.
• Comfortable working in a dynamic international environment with changing priorities.
• Demonstrates integrity, accountability, and a strong commitment to quality and patient safety.
• Embraces Straumann Group's Mission, Values, and collaborative culture.
• Demonstrates a "Player-Learner" mindset: communicates openly, welcomes feedback, continuously develops expertise, and actively contributes to the success of the team.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

  • Entwerfen Sie innovative, robuste und kostengünstige Verpackungslösungen, die die Produkt-, Fertigungs-, Regulierungs-, Qualitäts- und Kundenanforderungen erfüllen.
  • Technische Entscheidungen für komplexe Verpackungsherausforderungen über mehrere Produktfamilien hinweg vorantreiben.

Project & Technical Leadership

jobs.description:
Stellenausschreibung:

Die etkon (Schweiz) AG, Teil der Straumann Gruppe, ist schweizweit der grösste und einer der innovativsten Fertigungsbetriebe für zahntechnische Leistungen. • Wir bieten Zahnarztpraxen einen effizienten und wirtschaftlichen Zugang zu implantatgestützten und zahngetragenen Versorgungen. Wir fertigen zu 100% «Swiss Made» in hoher Präzision, ohne dabei Kompromisse bei der Qualität einzugehen.

Ziel der Funktion

Der Mitarbeiter Supply Chain Management organisiert, steuert und überwacht den gesamten Material- und Warenfluss vom Lieferanten über das Lager bis zur Produktion und zum Kunden. Er sorgt dafür, dass Material, Informationen und Sendungen strukturiert, termingerecht und wirtschaftlich durch das Unternehmen fliessen. Als interner Dienstleister unterstützt er alle Spezialisten in der Produktion proaktiv, damit diese optimal Arbeiten können und dass die internen Warenflüsse laufend optimiert werden.

• Aufgaben:

  • Material- und Bestandsmanagement
    • Sicherstellung der Materialverfügbarkeit für die gesamte Unternehmung
    • Überwachung von Mindestbeständen und Meldebeständen
    • Auslösen von Bestellungen gemäss Dispositionsvorgaben
    • Terminüberwachung von Bestellungen und Lieferungen
    • Wareneingangskontrolle (Menge, Qualität, Dokumentation)
    • Verwaltung und Pflege der Lagerbestände im System
    • Organisation der Lagerplätze und Lagerstruktur
    • Durchführung von Inventuren
  • Logistik / Versand
    • Mitarbeit bei der Verpackung und Versandvorbereitung von Kundenaufträgen (inkl. Lieferscheinerstellung, Organisation von Kurierfahrten)
    • Verwaltung von Versandmaterialien
    • Verantwortlich für den Import und Export
  • Prozess- und Kostenoptimierung
    • Aktive Mitarbeit bei der Optimierung der Lagerbestände
    • Verbesserung der Lieferzeiten und Verfügbarkeit
    • Mitarbeit bei Prozessoptimierungen entlang der gesamten Supply Chain
    • Unterstützung bei Make-or-Buy-Entscheidungen
    • Mitarbeit bei Wirtschaftlichkeitsberechnungen (Material, Lieferanten, Prozesse)
  • Qualität und Dokumentation (ISO-relevant)
    • Sicherstellung der Rückverfolgbarkeit von Materialien (Chargen)
    • Dokumentation von Wareneingängen und Lieferanten
    • Einhaltung der definierten Prozesse gemäss QM-System
    • Mitarbeit bei Risikoanalysen im Bereich Beschaffung und Logistik
    • Pflege von Materialstammdaten

Profil:

  • Absoluter Dienstleistungsgedanke
  • Sehr strukturierte und organisierte Arbeitsweise
  • Hohes Planungs- und Organisationsvermögen
  • Denkt in Prozessen und Abläufen
  • Arbeitet vorausschauend und nicht nur reaktiv
  • Hohe Zuverlässigkeit und Genauigkeit
  • Behalten auch bei vielen parallelen • Aufgaben den Überblick
  • Arbeitet systematisch und lösungsorientiert
  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung
  • „Sieht Arbeit“, bevor Probleme entstehen
  • Ruhig, überlegt, organisiert
  • Hands-on-Mentalität
  • Verbindlich und zuverlässig
  • Belastbar in Stresssituationen
  • Kommunikativ in der Abstimmung mit Lieferanten und internen Abteilungen
  • Denkt wirtschaftlich
  • Hat Freude an Ordnung, Systemen und Planung
  • Kaufmännische Grundausbildung und Erfahrung in Logistik, Disposition, Einkauf oder Supply Chain von Vorteil
